viewing_check: Estimate 30-50, current bid $20. This is the lot with real upside: single wooden blocks sell A$55-180 on eBay AU (about 9 sales in the last 18 months), and a 9-block lot sold A$104. Photo shows perhaps 10-15 pieces across two boxes, including what looks like a good dark timber block on a stand. Viewing check: size and maker stamps (Godfrey, Wm Brown etc), whether they are solid timber vs foam or modern balsa, cracks, and quantity. Bulky and heavy, posting each block costs A$15-30. Prices have risen slightly in 2026.
